/method/: The archive's method: how it reads Istrian registers online and what it learnt the hard way. Nothing else states the rules.
/sources/: The 159 sources the archive stands on, each with what it gave and where it is weak; every page's source block points back here. Now also carries a link from each deep-dive source to its study.
/searched/: The Search Register: 915 rows, each a source examined with its outcome, what it produced on this site, and (where it applies) a walked range. The only complete record of what was looked at, including every nil.
/open-questions/: 47 open and 37 closed questions with the next step for each, the deaths that ought to exist and cannot be found (#gaps), and the dossiers of who can take which.
/errands/: The errands (what has been asked of other people, or needs someone standing in a place) and the photographs wanted, shot by shot on the walks.
/worklist/: The work list: every open, running, blocked and done task, by number and date. The only place the 'why' of a decision is kept.
/corrections/: 271 claims published and taken back, each with what was said, what is true, and how it happened; one of the 12 pages of the linking standard.
/changes/: The feed of what the archive did and what it undid, day by day; the hand-written entries about the site itself (changes-built.json).
/gallery/: The Plate Room: images from the family's own papers or sent by archives on request, each readable on click, with the plates the corrections and the linking standard cite.
/whats-new/: The kit's pulse page: what was read, found and corrected lately, by source, newest first.
/archive/: The Pazin State Archives inventory (1,151 registers): custodian, years, digitised or not, which FamilySearch film each matches, the twenty-six books you cannot reach from a desk, the indexed records and the named dead.
/parish-books/: Every register volume photographed for the places this family came from, parish by parish through the FamilySearch image waypoints: Istria, Kvarner and Vinodol, Dalmatia, Carnia, and the HDA 1448 holdings.
/map/: The three-layer map: where the register volumes are and how far they have been read, where this archive can place a named person, where the family lies; plus the family's own Google My Map as drawn, and the finding about the twelve heaviest places.
/elsewhere/: The ten FamilySearch collections that file Croatian places under other countries, each with its state on the research map. Now a section of /collections-walk/ (#elsewhere); this address redirects.
/collections-walk/: The walk of FamilySearch's 3,488 collections on 15 September 2026: the 44 opened, each verdict (5 hold places on this family's ground, 39 nothing), and how to repeat the walk. Now also holds the ten of /elsewhere/.
/undigitised/: Every register in Pazin's own list marked 'not digitised' (154), whether anyone else has filmed it, the ones nobody has, ours first, and who holds them.
/antenati/: The Carnia civil registers on Antenati (Mione, Ovaro, Mieli): every volume's ark, how its identity was established, and whether it has been read. No name index exists for any of them.
/the-library/: The Poklon De Franceschi at the National and University Library in Zagreb: 2,480 items in 14 boxes, and what the project did not know.
/carlos-letter/: Carlo De Franceschi's reply of about 1873 to Giovanni Kobler on the Fiume families of the name: the letter, its provenance, and what it settles for this archive.
/carlos-book/: Carlo's L'Istria: note storiche (Parenzo, 1879), read whole: what it gives the home parishes, the Seget estate and its people, and its silence about Carnia.
/old-site/: The old Google Site defranceski.com captured and compared with this archive page by page, and what was written down as new.
/live-tree/: David's own live tree read against the roster: what the tree holds that this archive has never read, and what the archive holds that the tree has not (exported 16 September 2026).
/findmypast/: What a month's full Findmypast subscription reached that two expiring trials could not.
